info.name: Legal Contract Management API (ລະບົບຈັດເກັບຂໍ້ມູນ ພະແນກສັນຍາທົ່ວໄປ)
info.description:
API collection for Legal Contract Management System (NestJS Clean Architecture).
Includes endpoints for Auth, Contract Types (CRUD & Dropdown), Contracts, Attachments, Notifications, Users (Sync from HRM & Permissions), Support & Tickets, and Audit Logs.

item.name: 01. Auth (ການຢັ້ງຢືນຕົວຕົນ)
02. Contract Types (ປະເພດສັນຍາ CRUD & Dropdown)
03. Departments (ຫ້ອງການ/ຝ່າຍ CRUD, Sync HRM & Dropdown)
03. Contracts (ການຈັດການສັນຍາ)
